instrument: Raw NASA Task Load Index (Raw TLX) — DRAFT integration
construct: subjective task workload, not a fatigue-specific questionnaire
items: Mental Demand — How mentally demanding was the task? (Low to High)
Physical Demand — How physically demanding was the task? (Low to High)
Temporal Demand — How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task? (Low to High)
Performance — How successful were you in accomplishing what you were asked to do? (Good to Poor, reverse anchor direction)
Effort — How hard did you have to work to accomplish your level of performance? (Low to High)
Frustration — How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed or annoyed versus secure, gratified, content, relaxed and complacent did you feel? (Low to High)
proposed_scoring: Raw TLX = arithmetic mean of six numeric 0..100 ratings (no pairwise weighting); not yet integrated into production outcome analysis.
source: NASA official TLX overview and paper-and-pencil manual, https://www.nasa.gov/human-systems-integration-division/nasa-task-load-index-tlx/
warning: UNREVIEWED: proposed Raw TLX scale and descriptions; not a valid study measure until wording, scoring, provenance and protocol receive genuine review.
